library.name: Two-step serial barrier positive
library.composition: 有序交互A/验证A/交互B/验证B；各act可挂检查

library.name: Missing middle evidence → barrier blocks second effect
library.composition: 交互A后缺中间证据，停留等待/受控停止
library.obligation: 不跑A成功后置、不投递B；等待和终局按原Owner处理

library.name: Post-action contradicts desired state → second effect blocked

library.name: Fast perception final → verified completion
library.composition: 观察目标/交互/新观察/原Goal评估
library.obligation: 感知事实进入World后再匹配；文本检查不替代Goal

library.name: Fast misjudge → slow corrects → completion
library.composition: Fast错误→补充证据→World更正→重新绑定
library.obligation: 检查结果与旧观察关联，不把旧通过迁移到新目标

library.name: Fast-only misjudge → fail closed, no completion
library.composition: 缺少纠正证据，规则/检查未知
library.obligation: 不因唯一候选或handler存在而点击；原决策失败出口保留

library.name: Irrelevant + exact duplicate evidence → no revision growth
library.composition: 无关/重复观察不制造新工作
library.obligation: 去重由Evidence/World保证，handler记录不能靠新ID无限重查

library.name: Basis conflict + uncertainty change → grows revision
library.composition: 依据冲突→World修订→重评规则和检查
library.obligation: 冲突与Unknown保留；不得选择后项假装已知

library.name: Slow late arrival → belief revision via claim evolution
library.composition: 迟到更正→World演化→按当前依据续行
library.obligation: 旧handler结果保留来源，相关变化使继续条件重评

library.name: Four terminal completion states strictly distinct
library.composition: 完成/失败/安全停止/证据不足分别处理
library.obligation: Traversal Result不是第五种统一成功，也不代替原终局证据

library.name: Still wrong or conflicting → ambiguity, zero clicks
library.composition: 仍错误或冲突→未知/暂停
library.obligation: 不确定目标零点击；不将Finding当事实纠正器

library.name: P1 immediate termination — policy adopted, first fresh observation already satisfies termination (0 applications)
library.composition: 目标态已满足→只读核对→零交互
library.obligation: 无需为挂handler制造点击；原Goal仍独立证明

library.name: P2 repeated application — claim evolution 24->23->22->20 over two verified applications to policy success
library.composition: 复用目标态策略，24→23→22→20，每次动作独立验证
library.obligation: 同按钮可再次操作，visited不禁止必要重复；每个act有自己的检查输入

library.name: P3 no match — ClaimInSet out of direction domain (19) stops policy, reconsult at PolicyInvalidated
library.composition: 目标态规则域外19→无匹配→暂停/再咨询
library.obligation: 无规则不自动生成动作；不同于选择fallback完成目标

library.name: P4 bounds exhausted — MaxApplications=1 consumed, temp unchanged, reconsult at PolicyInvalidated
library.composition: 局部应用预算耗尽→保留消耗和缺口
library.obligation: 1次后不再动作，不因修订重置预算

library.name: P5 guard violated — ObservationUnchanged(temp,1) trips after consecutive unchanged rounds (2 applications)
library.composition: 连续无变化→既有停滞守卫→停止推进
library.obligation: no-progress是失败/缺口，不是发现穷尽或目标已满足

library.name: P6 guard Unknown — conflicted claim (fixed-scope value change) never satisfies guard, zero dispatch
library.composition: 守卫冲突Unknown→零新投递
library.obligation: 不能当false跳到其他操作；检查Unknown按声明继续条件处置

library.name: P7 verification failure midway — post-action contradicts DesiredState, existing VerificationFailed transition voids policy
library.composition: 中途验证失败→暂停原执行/再决策
library.obligation: 成功后置handler不执行；旧Effect不因修订被重放

library.name: P8 fresh-world change between applications — container identity drift invalidates semantic lease, zero new effect
library.composition: 两次动作间identity/lease漂移→绑定失效
library.obligation: 前置通过不沿用旧身份；继续前重检，零新Effect

library.name: P9 forbidden effect class — template EffectClass outside contract rejected by V6d at consultation
library.composition: 采纳前拒绝越权EffectClass
library.obligation: handler引用不能绕过既有拒绝，不能给越权能力换包装

library.name: P10 policy budget exceeds contract — MaxApplications > StepsRemaining rejected by V6c
library.composition: 采纳前拒绝超过Run授权的策略工作额
library.obligation: 新handler工作也需计入相应资源，不从计划参数获额

library.name: P11 unknown AST — foreign predicate kind mapped to rogue node through the real seam, rejected by V6a
library.composition: 拒绝未知AST/操作/谓词
library.obligation: 不把任意operation字符串反射成调用；typed接口有限声明

library.name: WiFi switch off→on (happy path)
library.composition: 未达目标→操作switch→独立验证→后置检查
library.obligation: 点击授权与元素语言检查分别执法，Goal不由handler宣布

library.name: Missing post-action stimulus → legal waiting
